summary: Iteration 20: Comprehensive testing of NEW Training Effectiveness Score feature. All 14 backend API tests passed (100%). All frontend UI components verified working correctly. The effectiveness score shows 77% GOOD based on 23 analyst-rated items.
passed_tests: GET /api/training/effectiveness returns 200
Response contains required fields: score, grade, sample_size, worst_misalignments, best_alignments, trend, delta_from_last
Score is 77.0 (within valid 0-100 range)
Grade mapping correct: score 77 -> GOOD (>=65 threshold)
worst_misalignments returns 5 items sorted by lowest alignment first (0.2, 0.6, 0.6, 0.7, 0.8)
best_alignments returns 5 items sorted by highest alignment first (1.0, 1.0, 0.8, ...)
Alignment items have valid structure: id, title, ai_severity, ai_mapped, analyst_avg, ratings_count, alignment
Alignment values are in 0-1 range
trend is empty array (no training runs since feature added - expected)
delta_from_last is null (no previous snapshot - expected)
Severity mapping verified: critical=6, high=5, medium=3.5, low=2
POST /api/training/add-url with relevance still works
GET /api/training/activity-log still works
GET /api/feedback/stats still works
GET /api/training/queue still works
Frontend: Training Effectiveness Score card renders with data-testid='effectiveness-score-card'
Frontend: Circular dial shows 77% with data-testid='effectiveness-dial'
Frontend: Grade badge displays 'GOOD' in blue with data-testid='effectiveness-grade'
Frontend: Sample size text shows '23 items analyzed'
Frontend: Description text explains alignment between AI classifications and analyst feedback
Frontend: 'Biggest Gaps (AI vs Analyst)' section shows 5 misalignment items with percentages
Frontend: 'Best Alignments' section shows 5 alignment items with percentages
Frontend: Each alignment item shows AI severity and User rating (e.g., 'AI:low | User:6')
critical_code_review_comments: Effectiveness score computation correctly uses SEVERITY_MAP: critical=6, high=5, medium=3.5, low=2
Alignment formula: max(0, 1.0 - abs(ai_score - analyst_avg) / 5.0) produces 0-1 range
Grade thresholds correctly implemented: >=80 EXCELLENT, >=65 GOOD, >=50 MODERATE, >=35 NEEDS_IMPROVEMENT, <35 POOR
worst_misalignments correctly sorted ascending by alignment (worst first)
best_alignments correctly sorted descending by alignment (best first)
effectiveness_snapshot entries will be stored in activity_log when training runs complete
Frontend correctly handles null score case with 'Not enough data yet' message
Frontend grade badge color coding: EXCELLENT=emerald, GOOD=blue, MODERATE=amber, others=red
test_credentials: No credentials needed - app has no auth system
seed_data_creation: No seed data created - tested with existing 23 analyst-rated items
